title: skills
summary: A personal collection of installable AI agent skills (via APM) for use with coding agents like Claude Code, including a dedicated "sdv-synthetic-data" skill. That skill's bundled scripts run SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN and HMA synthesizers and its quality-evaluation API to generate and validate synthetic tabular and multi-table data on demand.
evidence: skills/sdv-synthetic-data/scripts/generate_multi_table.py:61-98 imports HMASynthesizer, fits it; generate_single_table.py:59-66 instantiates GaussianCopula/CTGAN/TVAE/CopulaGAN synthesizers
needs: PARSynthesizer is only mentioned in SKILL.md as advice for unimplemented time-series scripts, not actually executed, so par_sequential concept was excluded.
